title: Labor coalition to PH, Asean: Stop normalizing Myanmar junta

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Labor coalition NAGKAISA urged the Philippine government and other Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) member states to stop normalizing relations with Myanmar’s military junta, citing continued attacks on civilians and violations of workers’ rights.
